result_text:
The contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer use `contributorsListLimit`. The `reports` module compiles. I did not run any tests, and I did not generate a report to check the output.

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`:** I removed the `.limit(limit)` call and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. This class builds the contributor tables, so `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, the bots page and the teams pages now list everyone. The sort order is unchanged.
- **`ContributorListsSection.java`:** I removed the `.limit(...)` in `getBarsHtml`, so the bar chart now has one bar per recently active contributor.

The `contributorsListLimit` setting is still in `LandscapeConfiguration`. Nothing in `reports` reads it any more.
